title: prunus sargentii var. compta
intro: Prunus sargentii var. compta, commonly known as Sargent Cherry, is a compact shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine to alleviate digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Sargent Cherry include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents present in Sargent Cherry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
